part.text:
Cache expiration is in `oxidepy/cache.py:13` — `TTLCache.get_or_set`.

How expiry is checked (`oxidepy/cache.py:15-18`):
- Each entry stored as `(value, timestamp)` where `timestamp = time.monotonic()` at write time (`line 20`).
- On lookup, `now = time.monotonic()` (`line 16`) and hit is fresh if `(now - hit[1]) < self.ttl_seconds` (`line 17`). If true, returns `hit[0]`; otherwise calls `producer()`, overwrites entry with new `(value, now)`, and returns it. No edit made.
